title: microsorum hymenodes var. marginale
intro: Microsorum hymenodes var. marginale, commonly known as Microsorum, is a type of fern plant that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Asia, where it is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Microsorum include wound healing, anti-diabetic, and anti-cancer activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides. However, more research is needed to fully understand the efficacy and safety of using Microsorum as a medicinal plant.
